blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The Cebu Greats will look to carry their winning momentum into the South Division semifinals of the SportsPlus MPBL (Maharlika Pilipinas Basketball League) 2026 Season when they face the back-to-back division champions Quezon Huskers on Wednesday, October 21. Cebu enters the best-of-three series brimming with confidence after sweeping Batangas City, 2-0, in the quarterfinals. The Greats also have a psychological edge over Quezon after escaping with an 80-79 victory in their elimination-round encounter.
